subject.title: fix: keep mapped hook content provenance scoped [AI]

question: Should mapped-hook Gmail provenance be limited to the matched `/hooks/gmail` path and resolved `hook:gmail:` session keys, even if some existing non-/gmail mappings relied on request-body `source: "gmail"`?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and security-aligned, but it intentionally changes upgrade behavior for any operator who used caller-controlled payload source to get Gmail-scoped unsafe/thinking behavior on another mapping.

options.title: Accept explicit provenance only
options.body: Keep the PR direction, require redacted real hook proof, and accept that non-/gmail mappings must use path/session key or mapping-level unsafe config for Gmail-like handling.

options.title: Add compatibility surface first
options.body: Pause merge and add an explicit documented mapping/session option if maintainers want payload-source-based Gmail provenance to remain reachable without trusting arbitrary request bodies.

recommendation.title: Accept explicit provenance only
recommendation.body: Keep the PR direction, require redacted real hook proof, and accept that non-/gmail mappings must use path/session key or mapping-level unsafe config for Gmail-like handling.
